authority: Installation and recurring capture both require explicit exact successor/plan authorization. Initial one-time grant does not authorize this plan. No AISP activation or wagering.
budgetSemantics: 200 includes the seven Sep18 capture calls; therefore at most 193 additional requests in this new period. Prior Sep14 eight-call ledger remains historical, not reset. 28/day includes all carried same-day calls. Shared CFBD/CBBD free entitlement checked before/after every batch.

cadence.checkpoint: Coalesced check within 45 minutes before T-7d/T-24h/T-6h/T-60m; 90-minute minimum spacing; freshness tested independently
cadence.corrections: Most recent completed week each capture; mandatory changed/new final weeks; one oldest past week daily; FBS master weekly
cadence.daily: 10:00 America/New_York while a supported slate is within seven days
cadence.postFinal: T+5h availability check, never an assumed final; unresolved status no more often than four hours, within all budgets
cadence.sourceCadenceQualification: CFBD supplies no guaranteed update cadence/SLA. Policy derives from 24h/2h freshness, 15m owner cadence and measured 86.86s capture+publisher run, not an invented source publication schedule.

conditionalRequests: Use retained ETag, else Last-Modified. 304 reuses exact prior bytes and preserves original acquisition time; new validation has its own timestamp and receipt. Response bytes 0. 200 unchanged content also reuses existing object.
credentialHandling: Value used only in Authorization header; never retained, logged, printed, or hashed

freshness.sourceCutoff: Actual latest acquisition or conditional validation; original raw acquisition is preserved separately

partialUpdatePolicy: Merge only retained eligible immutable past weeks; new/corrected required weeks all fetched within cap before complete admission. Missing schema/status/box/identity fails closed; no admitted-pointer advancement or partial slate.
recovery: Durable request reservation before HTTP. Completed capture can be admitted after interruption with zero network. An incomplete uncertain capture requires operator review, not retry. Completed per-game populations recover from publication journal.
stopConditions: Changed rights or unknown free entitlement
Required final stats not yet supplied
More mandatory correction weeks than fit within seven calls
storage: Private content-addressed raw objects outside Git. Conservatively include 7,782,336 previously accepted bytes in storage budget. No automatic deletion. Stop before storage ceiling.
